To be comparable with , we assess model performance using two types of metrics. First, for text reconstruction, we employ the following word-match metrics: BLEU , measuring n-gram similarities between the true and reconstructed text; ROUGE , reporting the recall of overlapping words of reconstructed text; Token F1, which calculates the multi-class F1 scores between predicted tokens and true tokens, considering each word as a class; and Exact-match, representing the percentage of perfectly matching reconstructed texts to the true texts.
